readingTie: This isn't a book review column. It's a window into what I'm reading, studying, or drawing from.
kitNote: Every template is typography and your own photography, so nothing depends on borrowed images. The formats are the part that is culturally fluent: the two panel setup, the text thread, the burned in caption. Those read as native on Instagram and TikTok without borrowing anyone else’s picture.
studiesDek: Guided studies you can walk through on your own or with a group. You read the passage and mark what stands out to you first. The questions come after that, and they build on what you noticed rather than telling you what to look for.
heroGospelLine: Jesus is King.|His freedom, peace and purpose are available now.
essaysHeader: The kingdom already started. It has not finished. We are living in the overlap.
